name: v4.0.533
body:
## What's Changed

- `remotion`: **Re-enable nested HTML-in-canvas from Chrome 157 and add `HtmlInCanvas.isNestingSupported()`** by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11855
- `@remotion/studio`: **Integrate with ChatGPT Codex annotation system** by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11944
- `@remotion/studio`: Allow reordering of multiple clips by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11946
- `@remotion/studio`: Infer timeline durations for `<Series>` and `<TransitionSeries>` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11950
- `@remotion/codemods`: Fix global keyframe timing inside `Series.Sequence` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11936
- `@remotion/lambda-go`: Remove duplicate Codec default assignment by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11858
- `@remotion/licensing`: Add idempotency keys to billable events by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11939
- `@remotion/mcp`: URL-encode documentation query parameter by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11937
- `@remotion/mcp`: Abort documentation fetch after 10 seconds by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11952
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix progressive slowdown in long renders by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11912
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix `--image-sequence-pattern` precedence over the config file by @developerjillur in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11959
- `@remotion/studio`: Reduce trim work in large timelines by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11846
- `@remotion/studio`: Add "Copy context for agents" to multi-sequence context menu by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11914
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix splitting clips with timing such as `trimBefore={4 * fps}` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11915
- `@remotion/studio`: Nicer format for duration in composition inspector by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11924
- `@remotion/studio`: Add leading space when splitting captions by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11926
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix hold transitions in timeline volume curves by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11927
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix marquee selection losing items when scrolling by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11930
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix timeline trim handles with premounting by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11935
- `@remotion/studio`: Clarify remotion.dev/new playground limitations by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11940
- `@remotion/studio`: Increase folder indentation in compositions and assets lists by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11941
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix timeline start snapping for nested layers by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11942
- `@remotion/studio`: Clamp timeline dragging at parent start by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11943
- `@remotion/studio`: Show trimmed layer extent during timeline drag by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11947
- `@remotion/studio`: Add ChatGPT actions for pre-compose and generation by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11951
- `@remotion/studio-server`: Fix Open in ChatGPT on macOS by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11931
- `@remotion/studio-server`: Contain find-in-file and file-existence watchers inside the project by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11961
- `create-video`: Skip esbuild install script in pnpm scaffolds by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11921
- `create-video`: Automatically choose to setup `.agents` and `.claude` when opting into Skills by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11922
- `create-video`: Install dependencies during project setup by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11948
- `create-video`: Remove Tailwind question and use existing non-interactive default by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11954

## Elements

- Change Basic Captions default time between pages to 3000ms by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11913
- Fix Studio insertion at the current playhead by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11957

## Docs

- Show timing props on custom components by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11849
- Replace redundant `<AbsoluteFill>` wrappers with fragments by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11945

## Internal and Experimental

- [`@remotion/sdk`: New package with experimental primitives for building Remotion authoring interfaces](https://remotion.dev/docs/sdk) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11857
- Skills: Clarify `<Audio>` imports from `@remotion/media` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11928
- Skills: Make connected compositions independent of parent styles by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11938
- Skills: Use composition FPS for editable clip timing by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11949
- Bump Next.js from 16.3.3 to 16.3.6 across monorepo by @app/dependabot in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11918
- Upgrade Turborepo to 2.11.6 by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11933
- `@remotion/jonnys-videos`: Add roller ski video by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11923
- Internal tests: Consolidate `@remotion/media` frame accuracy renders by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11963

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/compare/v4.0.532...v4.0.533
